name: Five Poisons Sect
description: Feared but not hated, the Five Poisons keep their valley and their peace. They refuse no student whose heart is steady, and they refuse no coin whose owner is clear-eyed. Their arts ride five venoms — viper, centipede, spider, toad, scorpion — and their first vow is the same as their last: 'We do not strike in anger; we do not apologise for the strike.'
